$comment: Microsoft Store packaging settings (docs/engineering/27-microsoft-store.md). Identity values are public, not secrets: copy them from Partner Center > your app > Product management > Product identity and commit them. Environment variables MSIX_IDENTITY_NAME, MSIX_PUBLISHER, MSIX_PUBLISHER_DISPLAY_NAME, MSIX_DISPLAY_NAME and STORE_PRIVACY_POLICY_URL override these values (CI repository variables). Values starting with REPLACE_ are placeholders and block Store builds.
